results.evidence_text: This study examined nine dichotomous variables including: exercise, history of vasectomy, smoking history, alcohol use, finasteride use, statin use, aspirin use, coffee use, and vitamin use.
results.one_sentence_explanation: ChatGPT's INCLUDE is supported because alcohol use was examined as a separate dichotomous prostate-cancer risk factor in an original human study, so the alcohol estimate is merely numerically unreported in the abstract rather than inseparable.
